items.title: CZ denies Binance sold crypto as Bitcoin bounces from four-month low near $62,000
items.summary: The price moves across the market led to $2 billion in crypto liquidations in a single 24-hour period over the weekend.

items.title: Bitcoin ETFs Lose $2.1 Billion in November as Outflow Streak Hits Seven Days
items.summary: Spot Bitcoin ETFs shed $185.4 million on Friday, their seventh straight day of outflows, pushing November losses to about $2.1 billion as Bitcoin fell toward $64,000.

items.title: Bitcoin falls to four-month low near $62K as crypto selloff deepens
items.summary: The global cryptocurrency market capitalization fell 4% to $2.26 trillion over 24 hours, while Ether and Solana posted double-digit weekly losses.

items.title: Kava Lend loses roughly $3.8 million to hack, sending KAVA token down nearly 40%
items.summary: About 49.2 million KAVA was bridged to BNB Chain via LayerZero and sold for roughly $2.1 million in BNB and USDT.

items.title: Bitcoin Price Falls 14% in a Week to $65,000 as Weekend Selling Breaks Friday's Low
items.summary: Bitcoin price crashed about 13% over the past week and traded near $65,600 on Saturday.

items.title: XRP crashes to its lowest since November 2024 as money leaves crypto
items.summary: XRP tanked to its lowest level since November 2024 as ETF outflows and shrinking stablecoin supply add to pressure on crypto markets.
